title: Gleam Harvester
body:
"A pickaxe carved from the strongest of rocks and infused with the power of Lumite crystals; use this tool and leave no stone unturned."

The Gleam Harvester is a pickaxe that can be purchased from the River Shop for 200 Lumite Credits.

The Gleam Harvester pickaxe has the largest impact radius on ore - meaning the impact is likely to spread throughout the entire ore deposit. But there is no guarantee that this pickaxe will mine every piece of ore or ordinary stone in one go.

This pickaxe mines large chunks of ore in 2-4 hits +/- depending on size.

Notes:

-The Uncertain Pickaxe is a better pickaxe for everyday use. But even so, the Gleam Harvester pickaxe is not without its merits.

-In terms of size, the Gleam Harvester pickaxe is the largest pick in the game relative to the player's height.

-This pickaxe emits a light green glow (which may slightly illuminate the area around you no further than 1 meter) this is due to the material from which it is made (Lumite).
